name: Fondy Commerce Payment Gateway
description: A Drupal Commerce off-site payment gateway for Fondy, with signature- and amount-verified callbacks.
project_description:
The Drupal Commerce payment gateway allows you to integrate the payment acceptance service on both a small personal blog and a large international online store during the day.

 Drupal is a powerful site management system. Resources database stores both content pages and information on sales: products, customers, orders, transactions, customer relationship history.

 Together with the Drupal Commerce plugin from the Fondy payment gateway, your resource can quickly and safely accept payments, offer different payment methods, and work with users from all over the world. After a short registration, installation, and activation of the module, customers will be able to pay for orders using bank cards, online banking or alternative methods.

 To integrate the Internet acquiring service, you do not need to involve third-party specialists: download the Drupal Commerce payment module, install it through the Drupal site control panel, activate and configure the page for your own business. More than 8,000 entrepreneurs worldwide use the tools of the Fondy platform: from thematic blogs and niche stores to international companies.

 The payment gateway operates in the UK, Ireland, Poland, and other EU countries, providing the ability to process transactions in major banks. We accept payment from customers from any country, supporting 100+ currencies. It is the variety of payment methods that increases customer loyalty, attract new customers, and increases the company's turnover.

 Back to top 

 Why the Fondy payment platform? 
 
 installing the Drupal Commerce payment gateway on the Drupal CMS takes a couple of minutes; 
 payments are processed simultaneously in 25+ acquiring banks and processing centers; 
 a variety of payment methods, including credit cards, online banks in 26 countries, and dozens of alternative methods; 
 connection of recurrent payments – debiting funds from the client's card/account with a certain frequency; 
 support for holding money – freezing money on the customer's card with the possibility of instant debiting or refund; 
 own anti-fraud system that automatically rejects fraudulent payments; 
 the mobile application that allows you to analyze payments, regardless of the place and time of day. 
 
 Back to top 

 What payment methods are supported 
 
 The Fondy platform supports dozens of bank cards, including Visa, MasterCard, and Maestro. 
 There is support for alternative payment methods: Trustpay, Alipay, SEPA, Skrill, and others. 
 Customers can pay for their order through the online banking services of banks in 26 countries. 
 
 Back to top 

 Features after connecting the Drupal Commerce payment gateway 
 Instant start 
 To enable receiving payments from the Fondy payment platform you don't need to waste a lot of time - just register in the system and activate the plugin. You need to create a personal account, specify your bank card or account details to receive funds, sign an electronic contract, and pass a quick audit of the Drupal site by our specialists.

 The entire procedure takes place online. Our support team will consult via Skype, email or phone, answering questions for quick connection of the payment gateway functionality. After completing the procedure, which is carried out during the day, you will be able to use the Internet acquiring service through the Drupal Commerce plugin for Drupal or use online invoicing for direct payment acceptance.

 A distinctive feature of the Fondy platform is loyal rates. Directly, the bank may refuse or offer an unprofitable tariff due to insufficiently attractive business turnover. We work with businesses of all sizes, offering profitable programs. But the connection to the system is free: you can use all the functionality, and the fee will be charged only from a percentage of the turnover.
